gold: Cutaneous Bacillus cereus infection with bacteremia

selector.rationale: The presence of vesicles with an erythematous base, focal epidermal and subepidermal necrosis, and numerous filamentous bacilli with septa on microscopic examination are consistent with Ecthyma gangrenosum, a characteristic skin lesion of Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection, especially in a neutropenic patient.

rejected.label: Bacillus anthracis infection
rejected.why: Low score and lack of specific evidence

rejected.label: Nectrotizing fasciitis
rejected.why: Low score and insufficient evidence of fascial necrosis

rejected.label: Neutropenic sepsis
rejected.why: While the patient is neutropenic and septic, this diagnosis does not specifically explain the skin lesions
